_notes: How each Iris tone becomes Cartesia voice settings. TUNE HERE, then listen in the tone tester (/tone-tester).
speed: 0.6 to 1.5 (1.0 = normal). volume: 0.5 to 2.0 (1.0 = normal). Cartesia treats both as guidance, not exact.

emotion: must be one of Cartesia's supported names (see docs.cartesia.ai, Sonic-3 volume/speed/emotion). Emotion control is BETA, English only, and only takes effect when it fits the words being said.

Cartesia has no 'joking' or 'serious'. serious -> calm (a primary, well-supported emotion). joking -> enthusiastic as an approximation; try 'sarcastic' or 'ironic' if you want a drier joke (they are not primary emotions, so results vary).
Voices differ a lot in how much emotion they show (Cartesia lists Leo, Jace, Kyle, Gavin, Maya, Tessa, Dana and Marian as most expressive). Put a voice id in 'voice' to change it.
